actions.title: Validate the suspected boundary omission
actions.rationale: This is an unproven risk; establish applicability and reproduce it before changing source.
steps: Review the recorded finding and the current feature requirements.
Identify the relevant source and test paths without assuming experimental files still exist.
Propose a focused regression test and commands for approval.
Implement a minimal fix only if the approved test demonstrates an applicable defect.
acceptanceCriteria: The risk is reproduced or explicitly dismissed with evidence.
Approved existing and new regression checks pass without weakening earlier checks.
